key_highlights: ASX on track for worst weekly performance since US-Iran conflict began, driven by mining and bank sell-offs
Oil surges near US$100/barrel as price suppression fails, pressuring energy importers and lifting energy producers
Iron ore enters 'bloodletting' phase; mining stocks tumble, with Canaccord-led cap raises signalling sector stress
AUD sharply weaker on growth scare; RBA flags rental inflation as key concern, complicating rate path
Queensland credit rating downgraded for first time since 2009, raising sovereign risk concerns
Housing market bifurcates: high-end prices crash while affordable segment and first-home buyers remain resilient
Australia softens gas reservation rules, easing Asian supply fears; Santos preservation cited as national priority
Chinese inflation surges, adding external demand uncertainty for Australian commodity exporters
Woolworths caught raising 'family staple' prices during Price Freeze promotion, hitting consumer confidence
Austal jumps on US$1.9b bid; gold exploration active in WA and NSW (Kuniko, Gateway WA)

sectors.trend: Sharp sell-off; iron ore in 'bloodletting' phase, mining stocks leading ASX decline. Cap raises (Crucible via Canaccord) signal capital-raising stress. Gold exploration (Kuniko, Gateway WA) shows selective resilience.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX under pressure from weak iron ore and Chinese inflation fears. Gold miners (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX) may benefit from safe-haven flows. Small-cap miners face funding risk.

sectors.trend: Banks tumbling alongside miners as bond yields rise and growth scare builds. Queensland credit downgrade adds sovereign risk. Superannuation policy debate (One Nation 'sugar hit') creates regulatory uncertainty.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin pressure from yield volatility. QLD downgrade may affect state-linked lending. Super policy risk could impact fund managers (HUB.AX, PPT.AX).

sectors.trend: Oil near US$100 on US-Iran tensions; Australia softens gas reservation rules. Santos preservation framed as national sacrifice. Gas supply easing benefits Asian buyers.
sectors.implications: SOL.AX, WDS.AX, GWO.AX benefit from oil/gas price strength. Downstream and importers (BRL.AX, AGL.AX) face input cost pressure. LNG exporters gain from Asian demand.

sectors.trend: Woolworths pricing controversy during Price Freeze undermines consumer trust. Housing affordability divergence supports first-home buyer activity. Tax burden concerns weigh on discretionary spend.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX face reputational and margin risk. REITs (GPW.AX, ICPL.AX) may see rental pressure. First-home buyer surge supports construction (WTC.AX, CGW.AX).

sectors.trend: Relatively insulated from commodity and rate shocks. CSL.AX and healthcare names offer defensive positioning. US tech earnings (Synopsys upgrade, Oscar Health) provide global sentiment support.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SVL.AX, WES.AX (pharma) benefit from risk-off rotation. Tech exposure via ASX-listed names limited but global flows supportive.

sectors.trend: High-end property prices in steepest decline; affordable segment resilient. Bathla collapse creates buyer uncertainty. RBA rental inflation concern supports long-term rental demand.
sectors.implications: Property REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX) face valuation pressure at premium end. Residential REITs may benefit from rental inflation. Construction/development names at risk from project cancellations.

key_themes: Oil near US$100 on US-Iran conflict reshapes energy and transport cost dynamics
Iron ore 'bloodletting' and Chinese inflation surge threaten mining revenue
AUD weakness on growth scare; RBA caught between rental inflation and growth
Queensland credit downgrade signals fiscal stress in state governments
Housing market bifurcation: luxury crash vs. affordable resilience
Gas policy liberalisation (Santos, reservation rules) reshapes energy security narrative
Superannuation populism (One Nation) creates regulatory overhang
Consumer confidence hit by tax burden perception and Woolworths pricing scandal

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil price spike near US$100 (US-Iran escalation)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; favour domestic gas/LNG producers over importers; monitor OPEC+ response

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore demand collapse / Chinese inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce BHP.AX/RIO.AX/FMG.AX weightings; rotate into gold and critical minerals

risk_assessment.risk_factor: AUD weakness and RBA policy uncertainty
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge AUD exposure; favour export-oriented and domestic-revenue names; monitor RBA rental data

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Queensland credit downgrade / state fiscal stress
risk_assessment.mitigation: Review state-linked infrastructure and construction exposure; monitor other state ratings
Avoid luxury property REITs; favour affordable-segment and rental-yield assets
Monitor regulatory changes; favour diversified fund managers with policy resilience

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight domestic energy and LNG producers
opportunities.rationale: Oil near US$100 and gas policy liberalisation support SOL.AX, WDS.AX, GWO.AX; Asian demand easing via reservation rule changes

opportunities.recommendation: Rotate into gold and critical minerals
opportunities.rationale: Iron ore bloodletting and Chinese inflation make gold a relative safe haven; Kuniko and Gateway WA exploration active; battery tech (Critical Resources) in testing phase

opportunities.recommendation: Selective healthcare and defensive consumer positioning
opportunities.rationale: Risk-off rotation; CSL.AX and healthcare insulated from commodity/rate shocks; Woolworths pricing issue may shift share to discounters

opportunities.recommendation: Austal on US$1.9b bid – event-driven trade
opportunities.rationale: M&A catalyst; aerospace/defence demand structural; short-term upside on bid completion

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce large-cap iron ore and diversified miner exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore bloodletting, Chinese inflation, and cap-raising stress signal multi-quarter revenue pressure

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD and reduce rate-sensitive REIT exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD smashed on growth scare; RBA rental inflation concern may delay cuts; high-end property in steepest decline

defensive_moves.recommendation: Monitor bank earnings for margin compression
defensive_moves.rationale: Bond yield volatility and QLD downgrade create credit and NIM headwinds for major banks

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to extend weakness over 1–3 months. Oil near US$100 supports energy but pressures transport and consumer sectors. Iron ore weakness and Chinese inflation cap mining recovery. RBA on hold with rental inflation as key constraint. AUD remains vulnerable. Expect elevated volatility around US-Iran developments and RBA communications.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if oil stabilises and Chinese demand recovers. Gas policy liberalisation and critical minerals investment (battery tech, gold) offer structural themes. Housing correction at luxury end may stabilise by H2 2027. Superannuation policy risk remains a wildcard. Domestic consumption supported by first-home buyer surge but constrained by tax burden perception.

Queensland and other state budget/fiscal responses to downgrade

Chinese CPI, PMI, and property sales data
Queensland and NSW state bond spreads
ASX mining sector cap raise activity (Crucible, Canaccord)
Housing price indices by segment (luxury vs. affordable)
Superannuation fund flows and policy announcements
